summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, reporting that on July 8, 2026, BlackRock, Inc. crossed a threshold for notification of a relevant change under AIM Rules, now holding 6.17% of voting rights (5.25% via shares, 0.91% via financial instruments). This is a routine passive disclosure of a major shareholding, not a special situation. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic event is involved. The filing is a standard regulatory notification of ownership change, equivalent to a US Schedule 13D/A submission but without any activist intent. No action or event requiring investor analysis.
